channel.title: *mohamed.sys — Systems Engineering & Concurrency Research
channel.description: Empirical research, architectural analysis, and systems engineering writings by Mohamed Hamed.

item.title: The Virtual Thread Concurrency Fallacy: Carrier Starvation and JDBC Pinning in High-Throughput Java 21 Runtimes
item.description: Empirical evaluation of Project Loom under intensive MVC workloads: why unmonitored migration causes 8/8 carrier thread starvation and how ReentrantLocks restore 48,000+ req/s throughput.

item.title: Contiguous Memory Layouts and SIMD Selection Vectors in Vectorized OLAP Engines
item.description: Dissecting SAP HANA TableStore columnar paradigms in Rust: bit-packed null masks, dictionary surrogate encoding, and morsel-driven SIMD scans yielding 3.96 billion elements per second.

item.title: Selective Undo via Vector Clock Inversion in Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs)
item.description: Mathematical convergence and undo semantics in distributed collaborative editors: implementing selective peer rollback without branch fragmentation using Yjs relative positions.

item.title: M.Sc. Dissertation: Java Virtual Threads in Spring Boot Applications (125-Trial Empirical Benchmark)
item.description: Formal academic dissertation defending at ELTE Faculty of Informatics: benchmarking throughput, thread pinning, and OS vs green thread concurrency across 125 reproducible trials.
